skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and transcribe key information from short dialogues and monologues in business and daily life contexts.
Communicate effectively in business and daily life contexts using basic vocabulary and sentence structures.
Comprehend main ideas and extract specific information from texts related to business and daily life.
Construct simple sentences and paragraphs to convey ideas in business and daily life contexts.
Recognize and use a range of vocabulary related to business and daily life contexts.
Apply basic grammatical structures in business and daily life contexts.
Demonstrate proficiency in English language skills for business and daily life contexts.
Analyze and interpret information from business and daily life contexts.
Participate in group discussions and collaborative activities in business and daily life contexts.
Communicate effectively in both written and spoken forms in business and daily life contexts.
